a radically different approach to vet emergency

Veterinary emergency care is not just our specialty, it’s all we do. We handle challenging cases day and night, and seamlessly give pet parents the peace of mind they deserve.
​
At VEG, we keep things completely transparent, from our fully open and immersive hospital environment to our focus on the customer. You see life-saving heroics as they happen, and can participate in your pet’s care as much as you want.
 
It’s an elevated animal ER experience that works for people and their pets.

Our Story. Our Mission.

Rose Lopez-McKinnon

My husband and his good buddy and fishing pal Nina were at the park the other day and a scary incident happened. Nina is a 2 year old Chihuahua with an incredibly sweet and loving disposition. Husband turned away for just a moment to speak with the game warden and heard his fishing pole move. He glanced around and Ms Nina had swallowed the treble hook that was surrounded by catfish powerbait. He clipped the line and called me in a frantic state. I looked up Emergency Pet Hospitals. Came upon VEG and decided to go there because it was close. By the time husband reached the clinic, he was hysterically weeping. He felt so guilty even though it wasn't his fault. She's a dog and catfish powerbait probably smells delicious to a dog. At the moment of arrival to the clinic, the staff displayed an amazing level attention and care. Not only for Nina, but for her Daddy too. It's so special there because they allow you to remain with your pet at all times. They x-rayed her and the hook was located in her esophagus. We had 2 choices...surgery or the Great Beyond. The veterinarian was Victoria, she is an angel incarnate. We were so stressed out with the decisions that need to be made. She gave us space, loving encouragement and guided us to the conclusion to at least try and save her with surgery. With steady hands, Victoria pushed the hook into her stomach, being careful not to tear any tissue on the way. She exposed her stomach, made an incision, and got the hook out without further incident. Victoria carefully stitched her up and off to the recovery area. Nina was highly medicated and high AF, so she had no clue what was going on. Britney made up a little area for me so that I could spend the night with Nina next to me. The love never wavered at any point while we were in the clinic for over 12 hours. Not just for us, but for EVERYONE that walked through the door. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone that needs a loving place to take their furry friends.

Crys Carter

Let me just note that not every veterinarian or emergency group will even see an exotic pet, especially a large bird. VEG Greenville will! I went to VEG Greenville at midnight on a Friday night. I was met at the door and taken to a room immediately. A medical staff member immediately assessed my Moluccan Cockatoo (Layla) and was kind and gentle with her. Layla had fallen in her cage and was showing great distress. Layla is 26 years old, this has never happened before, we were very concerned. Despite the practice being very busy, I met with multiple staffers and had several sessions with Dr. Jones directly. After a thorough physical exam, Dr.?Jones ordered an x ray and discovered that Layla was egg bound. The staff administered meloxicam pain medication, fluids, calcium and I believe the last medicine was oxytocin (not sure of this name). Layla’s treatment was not rushed (I was there 4.5 hours) she was monitored, cared for and also shown a great deal of love. This morning, 36 hours after her first indication that something was wrong, we were blessed with an egg. If Layla had not been able to pass the egg naturally, VEG Greenville provided me with a detailed plan for her treatment- which would have included surgery. The staff was with us every step of this process and truly answered our prayers. Some quick points I want to make that may not seem important, but they meant a lot to our family. -The staff made us feel heard and treated Layla like she was the most beautiful and important patient in the world. -I was exhausted (besides the hour of night I drove 1 hr and 15 minutes to get there) and I was offered snacks, fresh coffee, water and soda. -The rooms were private enough, but still allowed me to feel connected and within reach at all times -The facility is modern and very clean -The facility is well staffed. -I was expecting to pay significantly more than I was charged. -I was sent an electronic copy of Layla’s X-ray and medical records. - I received messages of support checking in on her progress. - I liked everyone I had the pleasure to deal with during this experience. -Every technician we dealt with was Licensed. Their education and experience showed. Thank you so much to the entire “midnight” staff. Special thanks to Dr. Jones (very bright, gentle and detailed), Ashley (who Layla may love more than she loves me) and Taylor (who thoroughly radiates kindness) All of these women were superior at their job, took the role seriously, were conscientious and made this difficult (potentially life threatening) situation, somehow better. God bless VEG Greenville, our family appreciated every little thing.

Thank you for everything, you all have a very special place in my heart.
